releaseNotes:
1. Crossings Abstract Excel (.xlsx) & PDF (.pdf) Export: Added filtered export (All/Selected Feeder, All/Selected Category) with 3-sheet formatted Excel workbook (Crossings Abstract, Crossing Details with frozen headers & AutoFilter, Import Template) and multi-page A4 Landscape PDF report with preview, Save, and Share.
2. Validated Excel Import & Safe Transaction: Exported workbooks can be edited and re-imported with row-by-row validation, duplicate/conflict detection, GIS route/dataset intersection protection (flagging unverified edits as Needs Review), Import Preview dialog, pre-import safety backup, and atomic SQLite transaction with audit history.
3. Voltage-Based Tower Marker Shapes: 230kV feeder tower Location Number badges now render as compact rounded rectangles while 110kV and other voltage levels preserve the existing circular badge, keeping alphanumeric labels (31A, 4T, 10/1T, 26/1) intact.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Fast Buffered In-App OTA Downloader: Replaced per-8KB EventChannel/setState flooding with a direct buffered Dart HttpClient stream, single-pass chunked SHA-256 verification, and throttled progress updates (only on % change or >=250ms).
2. Native FileProvider APK Installer Channel: Added a lightweight MethodChannel to launch Android's package installer directly for the verified APK without legacy plugin overhead.
3. Fast Pre-Update Safety Backup: Replaced full-DB in-memory exportDatabaseBytes() with PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) before copying the SQLite snapshot, eliminating pre-download memory spikes and delay.
